entries.description: Ran the adversarial construction before the proof attempt, per the pre-registration's stated reason rather than out of habit. The pre-registered target (24 depth-2 subcases) was moot within the hour; a proof attempt would have spent the session on case analysis toward a false theorem.

Corrected three stale prose sections in the same commit rather than deferring: the file header, the 'does NOT do' list, and the 'any-depth conjecture (open)' section all asserted an open conjecture that the same commit refutes. Binding-integrity discipline — prose and theorems must not disagree at any commit.

Shipped subTree_eval_needs_positivity, a machine-checked counter-specimen showing the identity FAILS at a.eval = 0, alongside the positive result. Without it the closure theorem reads as unconditional; the positivity hypothesis is doing real work and a reader should be able to see it fire.

findings.description: x + 1 IS an EML tree at depth 4. The any-depth addition-closure conjecture (open in the repo since 2026-06-13) is FALSE. Gadget: log.exp = id lets eml NEGATE a subtree via the divisor position; negating twice adds.

The general conjecture falls too: EML is closed under addition of two arbitrary trees wherever one summand is positive (addTree_eval). The 2026-06-13 note's circularity was real only along its own route; log.exp = id routes around it.
